pairwise_observed_only.definition: For each sampled pair, compare only common OBSERVED Topics after centering each student over that shared Topic set. UNKNOWN values are excluded.

observability.unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN means train/history exposure equals zero. Its numeric model prior is never treated as observed mastery.

simple_signal_baselines.definition: All scores are fixed from MODEL-1 train/history. Rasch uses train/history fit and validation-only epoch selection.
